value:
Where you are
Into Needlehaven
Pines crowd in thirty feet from the western wall, a mine road and a tangle of hunting trails lead into them, and daylight is the only cover.
Things are close to breaking.
About this story
You have just signed on at the Adventurer's Guild in Aegis City, with no party yet. Belle, a headstrong barbarian, and Dalan, a shy elf ranger, are looking for one too. The postings on the board are small, the pay is modest, and every rank has to be earned. Expect frontier fantasy with a dark edge: real danger, mysteries that open one clue at a time, and choices that cost something. Bring any adventurer you like; the Guild takes all kinds.
Recently
You left What Wendhope Knows behind and moved into Into Needlehaven.
Open threads
The party must face whatever is scraping on the stone ahead in the root-filled tunnel.
Wendhope's wall is short on arrows while Halena counts them, leaving the defenders under-supplied.
The party intends to enter Needlehaven to find where the pale roots begin.
The party is now inside Needlehaven forest at dusk, facing the first wave of Screechers among the roots.
The strange echoing voice in the tunnel and what Duggy was waiting to see remain unexplained.
The story so far
Max registered a new party at the Guild in Aegis City under the name the Grey Pennants, alongside Belle, a barbarian out of the Mountains of Shadow, and Dalan, a quiet elf archer who had drifted between parties for a year. Both had been looking for a party, and the Guild sends no one out alone. Ellie recorded the party's name in the Guild's great book and slid the quest slip to Max. Max committed the three of them to the Investigate Wendhope posting, though Tobias had not yet written the party's name in the ledger, leaving the commitment unconfirmed.
Following along.
Waiting for the next reply.
